title: Pool_Exhaustion crisis can never resolve when pool_max_packets is 1 or 2 (legal catalog values, no clamp like the E9 path)
evidence:
core/crisis.odin:386-387: "// the margin clamps to bound-1 so a tiny catalog bound (1-2
// packets) can never make resolution unreachable (bound <= margin"
core/crisis.odin:412-413: "cleared = len(state.flow.packets) + int(CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN) < int(cat.balance.pool_max_packets) &&
				!drop_of_reason_this_tick(state, .Pool_Exhaustion)"
core/catalog.odin:620-622: "b.pool_max_packets = jint(obj, "pool_max_packets", 0)
if b.pool_max_packets <= 0 {
return {"balance.json", "pool_max_packets", "pool_max_packets must be > 0 (in-flight pool cap, E22)"}"
detail: The E9 resolve path clamps CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN for tiny bounds so resolution stays reachable; the pool path has no equivalent. With cap 1-2 (validation only requires > 0), len+2 < cap is unsatisfiable: a triggered pool crisis never resolves, banner persists forever.
recommended_fix: Mirror the E9 clamp: if pool_max_packets <= CRISIS_RESOLVE_MARGIN, resolve on len < cap (no margin), or reject pool caps below margin+1 at catalog load.

title: STILL-PRESENT: types.odin Event comment retains the false "pre-3.3/3.4/4.1/4.2 event streams stay byte-identical" sentence the W3-carry amendment was supposed to correct
detail: The r3 amendment added the fold admission but left the directly contradictory sentence (serialize.odin states pre-4.2 event streams are NOT byte-identical) verbatim. The mandate (d) demanded types.odin match serialize.odin/change-log; the carry is incomplete.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the final sentence to serialize.odin's wording: pre-4.2 drop payloads were class+reason only, so pre-4.2 event streams are NOT byte-identical; tags 8/9 remain append-only.

title: Re-touched app HUD title keeps a non-ASCII em-dash through byte-truncating draw_text — renders a garbage glyph in the live app
detail: draw_text truncates each rune to u8 — the em-dash (U+2014) becomes byte 0x14, the identical mojibake class the rework fixed in the banner title strings. This diff rewrote the title line while keeping the em-dash; the harness captures never show it (HUD is app-only).
recommended_fix: Replace "—" with ASCII "-" in the title literal, matching the W-render banner fix applied to draw_text_c-fed strings.
